# Analysis Splitting Techniques (Requirements Gathering)

When a feature request is too large, vague, or purely conceptual, split the work into smaller **Business Analysis Subtasks** to gather requirements. Use the following patterns:

## 1. Identify the Core Action
Determine the absolute simplest action the user can do and map the exact steps.
- *Goal:* Find the starting point of the user journey.

## 2. Map the Exceptions
List what happens when the core action fails or encounters a roadblock.
- *Goal:* Identify edge cases before development starts.

## 3. Define the Data
List all the fields, inputs, and outputs the user needs to provide or see to complete the action.
- *Goal:* Establish the required data model from a business perspective.
